answer.explanation: The request rq-103 for an espresso machine ($890) was blocked and will not be charged to grant R21AI182745. It failed the rule Category allowed, because general office is not an allowable direct cost on a federal grant; see the NSF OIG audit of UC Davis: unallowable items charged to awards. The grant itself was active, had enough available funds, and was under the $5,000 card limit, but it cannot be charged to a federal grant.
